narrative.overview: Warm editorial surfaces, forest actions, Playfair headings, and DM Sans interface text extend across all routed pages, including tools, workspace, guides, forms, and error/loading states. The homepage retains its integrated paper atlas and optional motion. This visual migration does not establish backend or service readiness.
keyCharacteristics: Light paper interiors and forest actions
Playfair Display headlines with DM Sans interface text
Semantic paper, surface, ink, pine, quiet, line, wash, and brass roles
Quiet dividers, flat interior cards, and visible focus

rules.name: Motion access
rules.body: Respect reduced motion, expose Pause motion, and pause the atlas when hidden or outside the viewport.

rules.name: Interior surfaces
rules.body: Use light paper pages, surface cards and fields, ink text, and brass focus across tools and document pages. Keep service readiness separate from visual review.

dos: Preserve visible focus, descriptive labels, and existing tool interactions.
Use semantic interior tokens across pages.
Preserve homepage pause and reduced-motion behavior.
donts: Do not place the atlas inside an opaque raised card.
Do not restore dark bodies, neon gradients, blur, or glow as the default interior style.
Do not equate visual migration with backend readiness.
Do not add unsupported marketing claims.
